record.field: SELECT c.vgpos, c.posnr, a.seqnr, a.trucknr, a.arrdate, a.donr, e.ebeln, a.matnr, a.doqty, a.ldtype, d.umrez, d.umren, a.lgort, a.werks AS penerima, a.lifnr AS pengirim FROM zmm_ts_in_po a LEFT JOIN zmm_ts_arr_pool b ON a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate LEFT JOIN lips c ON a.donr = c.vbeln AND a.matnr = c.matnr LEFT JOIN marm d ON d.matnr = a.matnr AND d.meinh = a.ldtype left join zmm_ts_sto e on a.donr = e.vbeln_vl WHERE b.srctab = 'ZMM_TS_ISTO_NCPL' AND TO_DATE(a.arrdate,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE-30 AND CURRENT_DATE

SELECT a.werks, a.seqnr, a.trucknr, a.arrdate, a.ebeln, a.ebelp, a.matnr, a.qtypo, a.uoe, a.erfmg, a.meins, d.umren, d.umrez,c.slocto as kesloc,c.slocfrom as darisloc FROM ZMM_TS_STO_NCD a JOIN zmm_ts_arr_pool b ON a.werks = b.werks AND a.seqnr = b.seqnr AND a.trucknr = b.trucknr AND a.arrdate = b.arrdate JOIN ZMM_TS_STO_NCH c ON a.werks = c.werks AND a.seqnr = c.seqnr AND a.trucknr = c.trucknr AND a.arrdate = c.arrdate JOIN MARM d ON a.matnr = d.matnr AND a.uoe = d.meinh WHERE b.srctab = 'ZMM_TS_ISTO_NCSL' and b.w_odoo = ' ' and c.mblnr_ref != ' '
